reason: My buyers come from IndiaMART, phone and old contacts, not from a website, and my staff already send quotes on WhatsApp. Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month is over a lakh in the first year, and my CA will ask what extra orders it brings, and I can't answer that.
objection: A website alone won't bring buyers, and the quote desk only saves typing time. It doesn't get me new enquiries. And it's a small remote studio with one chemical client to show. If they disappear, who keeps the monthly thing running?
would_change_my_mind: Let me talk to that chemical-trading client and see real numbers on faster quotes turning into more orders. Or let me pay only for the quote desk as a monthly trial on my IndiaMART enquiries, with no big setup fee first.
